svg.title: Azure Local VM connectivity
svg.desc: Azure Local guest VM Arc connectivity. Outbound proxy means a customer-configured forward proxy, not the Arc proxy inside a guest. Guest applications have their own customer-controlled proxy and bypass settings. Arc-enabled guests do not use the host cluster IP proxy or host Arc tunnel. Enabling a gateway does not automatically proxy arbitrary guest application traffic. Packet motion is continuous and illustrative; reduced-motion preferences hide moving packets. The outbound proxy and Arc gateway are independent choices. The firewall represents network transit, not TLS inspection. The detailed views illustrate forwarding responsibilities, not a prescribed ExpressRoute, VPN, NAT, or internet topology. Every configuration still requires a permitted route to its public endpoints. With Arc gateway enabled, each guest uses its own Arc proxy and tunnel, even if the Azure gateway resource is shared. Proxy / Arc gateway. The guest Arc agents use the Arc proxy inside this VM and a guest-specific HTTP CONNECT tunnel to the public Arc gateway. The customer-configured outbound proxy forwards the connections. Azure Firewall explicit proxy is the example shown, not a requirement to use that product. Required destinations outside gateway coverage use a separate permitted egress path, through the outbound proxy if configured.
svg.text: Guest Arc connectivity / outbound proxy: on / Arc gateway: on

path.title: Guest Arc agents use the Arc proxy inside this VM, not the host cluster IP proxy.
Guest-specific Arc gateway HTTP CONNECT tunnel through permitted firewall transit and the configured outbound proxy. This does not reuse the host tunnel.
Arc gateway forwards supported HTTPS to Azure services.

Required endpoints outside gateway coverage need separate permission through the configured outbound proxy. These can include Azure endpoints and other service destinations; the branch does not represent all guest application traffic.

g.text: Guest applications keep their own proxy configuration.
No proxy still requires permitted network routing. Arc gateway does not cover every service endpoint.
